```{r}

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(stats, dynlm, lmtest, sandwich, urca, quantmod, exuber, readxl, exuberdata, ggplot2)

load("allData.RData")

y <- log(price) - log(dividend)
#this step is necessary or radf() will return error
y_vec <- ts(as.numeric(y), start = c(1926, 3), frequency = 12)

est_y <- radf(y_vec, lag = 1)
summary(est_y)


#selecting lags
adf_model_y <- ur.df(y_vec, type = "drift", selectlags = "AIC")
summary(adf_model_y)
# suggests one lag

# Reject null at 5%, evidence of explosiveness
diagnostics(est_y)

#Implementing rule-of-thumb proposed by Phillips et. al (2015) to compute minimum duration of an episode of "exuberance"
rot = psy_ds(length(y), rule = 1, delta = 1)

#trying to date periods of exuberance
dstamp_y <- datestamp(est_y, min_duration = rot)
dstamp_y
# no period from the 2020s makes this criteria

y2 <- ts(as.numeric(log_price), start = c(1926,3), frequency = 12)

adf_model_y2 <- ur.df(y2, type = "drift", selectlags = "AIC")
summary(adf_model_y2)

est_y2 <- radf(y2, lag = 1)
summary(est_y2)
diagnostics(est_y2)
#reject null at 1%
roti = psy_ds(length(y2), rule = 1, delta = 1)
dstamp_y2 <- datestamp(est_y2, min_duration = roti)
dstamp_y2

autoplot(est_y) + labs(title = "log price/dividend")
autoplot(est_y2) + labs(title = "log price")

#cleanup
rm(PPIACO)


#OLS
regName1 <- lm(log_price ~ log_dividend)
#regName1_2 <- ar.ols(x = regName1, order.max = 12, demean = F, intercept = T)
regname2 <- dynlm(ts(log_price) ~ L(ts(log_price)) + L(ts(log_price), 2))
#
coeftest(regName1, vcov. = vcovHC, type = "HC1")

#Engle-Granger test for cointegration of prices and divs
FS_EGADF <- dynlm(ts(log_price) ~ ts(log_dividend))
FS_EGADF
# log_price = 3.02 + 1.26 * log_dividend, theta = 1.26
z_hat <- resid(FS_EGADF)
ur.df(z_hat, lags = 6, type = "none", selectlags = "AIC")
#ADF test statistic returns -3.9438, reject null hypothesis at 5%, z_hat is stationary
#critical values are -3.12, -3.41, and -3.96 respectively
#indicates log prices and log dividends cointegrated
```
